review: No defect found in rotation coverage, signed product encoding, duplicate-edge indegrees, or Kahn acyclicity test.
coverage_argument: Each GP relation has a distinguished pivot. Simultaneous sixfold rotation sends its pivot to the unique phase-zero point in its orbit; all four-element subsets of other points are then enumerated. The action on a pivot is free, giving exactly 27,307,560/6 representatives.
limitations: Only directed product-vertex cycles; arbitrary weighted exponent cancellations are not exhausted.
crosschecks: Three direct Python edge comparisons, including a known cyclic case, are retained with full enumeration.
